english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter contains a strong, dominant substrate layer organized around two major teaching units: (1) the transmission of the Ambassador's image through Sin/Matter to the rulers who shaped Adam and Eve (¶1-4), and (2) the faculty-storehouse system of the body (¶6-24, 27-28), which is one of the most systematic body-cosmos correspondences in the Kephalaia. The faculty-storehouse teaching maps five senses to five faculties, each with internal storehouses and repositories, governed by the heart-faculty. This is followed by a gates/watchmen correspondence mapping body orifices to a fortified camp. The Light Mind's entry and transformation of the body's systems completes the cosmological architecture. Editorial additions are light: dialogue frame attributions (easily stripped), one pedagogical summary closure (¶5), one editorial bridge applying the transformation teaching to institutional Manichaean worship practices (¶26), and a final exhortation (¶29). The chapter shows mild editorial fatigue in ¶25-26 where worldly examples and institutional vocabulary enter the application of the faculty transformation. Gardner notes the unusual shift from 'Light Mind' to 'Holy Spirit' terminology in ¶28.
